findings.title: Global view permission bypasses client-specific denials
findings.body: canView(ClientModel) returns true as soon as canView() grants the all-clients VIEW permission, without evaluating permissions on the requested client. Consequently, an administrator granted VIEW on all clients can still read a client for which a client-specific VIEW permission explicitly denies access. This defeats the resource-specific override behavior used by V2 permissions (and tested for users in UserResourceTypeEvaluationTest). Keep the built-in admin-role shortcut, but evaluate fine-grained view access through the client-specific resource, falling back to the all-clients resource only when appropriate.
